# Task: Finish the GitSim migration — zero real git in the default test suite

Earlier waves built the in-memory simulator and migrated the driver family
(completed tasks `02-in-memory-git-simulator`, `03-migrate-git-tests-to-simulator`,
`eliminate-real-git-default-for-tests`, `04-required-git-invoker-threading`),
but 18 test files still shell out through `TestGit.Run` and 28 still construct
a real `new GitInvoker()`. Policy for this task: the DEFAULT suite runs zero
real git processes. Where GitSim can't express something a test needs, that is
a GitSim gap — extend GitSim, and pin the new behavior against real git in the
opt-in parity suite.

### Evidence (2026-07-19 slow-test investigation)

Remaining real-git families, with real-git process spawns per test and solo
measured times (VM, filtered runs; reported times from the host's parallel run
were 5-37s for these same tests):

| Family | Spawns/test | Solo | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| HistoryRewriterTests | 16-17 | 0.57-0.93s | export/replay, per-commit `diff-tree` |
| RewriteHistoryRunnerTests | ~33 | 0.96s | export runs twice, replay via `commit-tree` |
| AuthorshipClaimerTests | 8-14 | 0.4-0.8s | trailer rewrite chain |
| CompletionTimeResolverTests | 8-10 | ~0.25s | tier 3 = `log --follow` |
| RelayTaskRepositoryCompletionTimeTests | ~11 | 0.29s | two tier-3 probes |
| EarlyImplementationDetectorTests | 8-9 | 0.24-0.28s | detector diff/status calls |
| CommitLintRunnerTests | 5-9 | 0.1-0.22s | git only in fixture setup |
| HookInstallerTests | 4-7 | 0.15s | hook never executes |
| SourceEnumerationGuardTests | ~7 | 0.20s | guard runs `ls-files` twice |
| TaskRewriteRunnerTests (+Cancellation) | ~9 | 0.23-0.26s | real `worktree add/prune/remove` |
| ProjectBootstrapperTests | ~14 | 0.37-0.39s | bootstrap chain EXECUTES the installed bash pre-commit hook |
| SetupCheckResultsTests | 12-14 | 0.41-0.46s | via `BootstrapAsync` defaulting `new GitInvoker()` (`ProjectBootstrapper.cs:67`) |
| MainWindowViewModelTests (bootstrap/ensure/archive) | ~12 | 0.6-2.84s | same chain + toolchain probe |
| RelayQueueControllerTwoPhaseTests / DrainTests | 15-20 | 0.4-1.6s | controller defaults `_gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker()` (`RelayQueueController.cs:162`, `RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs:40`) |
| RelayDriverResumeFlaggedWorkTests / …3Tests | varies | 0.5-1.4s | real `git bundle` create/verify/restore |

- `tests/VisualRelay.Tests/TestGit.cs` is the real-git shell-out helper (18
  files). `tests/VisualRelay.GitSim` already models add/commit/worktree/
  bundle/cherry-pick/log/ls-files/status/hooks (`Commands/`, `GitSimHooks.cs`).
- Guard precedent: `tools/VisualRelay.Guards/RealGitFallbackGuard.cs` bans
  `new GitInvoker(` and defaulted `IGitInvoker` parameters, but only under
  `src/VisualRelay.Core/Execution/` (`:34`).
- Parity anchor: `tests/VisualRelay.Tests/RealGitIntegrationTests.cs` is
  opt-in via `VR_RUN_SLOW_INTEGRATION=1` (skipped by default), with
  `ParityHarness.cs` — this suite is the real-git oracle that keeps GitSim
  honest, and after this task it is the ONLY place real git runs.

### What to build

Work family-by-family, one commit per family, suite green after each:

1. **Inventory first.** Regenerate the two lists (`TestGit\.Run` and
   `new GitInvoker\(` under `tests/VisualRelay.Tests`) and keep them in the
   run summary as the migration checklist. Counts above are as of 2026-07-19.
2. **Migrate each family to GitSim.** Replace `TestGit.Run` setup with
   `GitSim` seeding (patterns: `RelayDriverTestHelpers.InitTestRepo`,
   `GitSimTestHelpers.cs`) and inject the sim wherever a real invoker was
   constructed. Production seams that silently default to real git get the
   `04-required-git-invoker-threading` treatment: make the invoker required
   and thread it — starting with `RelayQueueController.cs:162` and
   `RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs:40` (composition roots — the App
   and the drain tool — construct the real invoker explicitly), and
   `ProjectBootstrapper.cs:67`.
3. **Close GitSim gaps as they surface.** Known/likely gaps to expect:
   `log --follow` rename tracking (CompletionTimeResolver tier 3), `bundle`
   create/verify/unbundle fidelity (FlaggedWork round-trips), `worktree
   prune`, `commit-tree`/`diff-tree` shapes used by HistoryRewriter, and
   installed-hook semantics (model the hook FILE plus the existing
   `GitSimHooks` verdict delegates — GitSim never executes real scripts).
   Every gap closed gets (a) a GitSim unit test and (b) a parity case added
   to the opt-in real-git suite asserting GitSim's output matches real git
   for that command shape.
4. **Retire and guard.** Delete `TestGit.cs` once it has zero users. Add a
   test-side guard (new `TestRealGitGuard` in `tools/VisualRelay.Guards`,
   mirroring `RealGitFallbackGuard`, run from a guard-as-test over
   `CachedSyntaxTreesFixture`) that flags, under `tests/VisualRelay.Tests`:
   `new GitInvoker(` and any `ProcessStartInfo` whose file name is `git`.
   Exemption list: exactly `RealGitIntegrationTests.cs` and
   `ParityHarness.cs`.

### Constraints

- Coverage is non-negotiable: no test deleted, skipped, or weakened. Every
  migrated test carries a name-by-name mapping (old name → new location) in
  the run summary. A scenario that genuinely asserts REAL git behavior moves
  into the opt-in parity suite — gated is fine, gone is not.
- GitSim stays in-memory: no subprocesses, no real clock, no script
  execution.
- The default `./visual-relay test` run must end with zero real git spawns;
  the parity suite stays opt-in (`VR_RUN_SLOW_INTEGRATION=1`) and is the only
  exemption.
- One family per commit; keep files under the 300-line guard.

### Tests (red first)

- Per family: migrate the test, watch it fail if GitSim lacks the command,
  extend GitSim with its own failing-first unit test, then green the family.
- Parity: each new/changed GitSim command gets a `VR_RUN_SLOW_INTEGRATION`
  case comparing GitSim output to real git output for the same operations.
- Guard: synthetic source with `new GitInvoker(` in a test file yields one
  violation; the migrated repo tree yields zero.

### Commit-message evidence

Measure before and after while implementing (per-family solo class times, and
a final full-suite number for the batch), then put one filled-in evidence
bullet in each commit's message body, following the attached
`commit-message-evidence.md`. Never pre-fill those bullets — numbers are
measured at implementation time and go into the eventual commit messages,
nowhere else.

# Commit-message evidence for test-speed changes

Any commit that changes how long tests take must carry, in its commit-message
body, exactly one bullet of this shape, blanks filled with real measurements:

- test time dropped from <before> to <after>, saving <delta> (<scope>)

How to fill it in:

- `<before>` / `<after>`: numbers you measured yourself, on this machine, with
  the same command, once right before starting and once right after finishing.
  Never copy them from a task description, an estimate, or a prediction.
- `<delta>`: the difference between the two.
- `<scope>`: what the numbers cover: `full-suite wall time`, `single test`, or
  `<TestClass> file total`.
- A finished example:
  `- test time dropped from 80s to 60s, saving 20s (full-suite wall time)`

Rules:

- The filled-in bullet belongs in the commit message body, never in a task
  file. A task file states the requirement; only the commit records numbers.
- Exactly one evidence bullet per commit. The commit hook allows at most 3
  body bullets of at most 20 words each, all `- ` hyphen bullets, no em
  dashes; keep the evidence bullet well inside those limits.
- If you cannot measure a real improvement, say so in your run summary and do
  not invent numbers. A commit with no measured effect gets no evidence bullet.

## Diagnostic: Finish the GitSim migration — inventory, gaps, seams, and migration plan

### 1. Current state snapshot

**18 files use `TestGit.Run`** (real-git shell-out helper):
SwivalSubagentRunnerContractRetryTests, TestDurationTests, SourceEnumerationGuardTests, CompletionTimeResolverTests, RelayDriverGitCommitGitignoredBackstopTests, ObsidianVaultLayoutProjectNameTests, GitInvokerTests, VerifyWorktreeDeletionOverlayTests.Symlink, HookInstallerTests, TaskRewriteRunnerTests, GateAsTestSandboxGuardTests, EarlyImplementationDetectorTests, NonoRollbackSkipDirsTests, TaskRewriteRunnerCancellationTests, PlanPhaseTestDoubles, GitBootstrapperTests, ProjectBootstrapperTests, SwivalSubagentRunnerManifestExistenceTests.

**28 files construct `new GitInvoker()`** (real process launcher bypassing the interface).

Of the 28, several are **legitimate exemptions** that must remain:
- `RealGitIntegrationTests.cs` — opt-in parity suite (`VR_RUN_SLOW_INTEGRATION=1`)
- `RealGitIntegrationDriverTests.cs` — opt-in parity suite
- `ParityHarness.cs` — harness for parity suite (asserts GitSim ≈ real git)
- `GitInvokerTests.cs` — tests GitInvoker resolution itself
- `GitInvokerProbeCacheTests.cs` — tests GitInvoker probe caching
- `DiBypassGuardTests.cs` — tests the DI-bypass guard (synthetic `new GitInvoker()`)
- `RealGitFallbackGuardTests.cs` — tests the real-git fallback guard (synthetic)

One file is already **opt-in gated**:
- `GitBootstrapperTests.EnsureRepositoryAsync_EmptyFolder_InitializesRepoWithResolvableHead` — calls `SlowIntegration.SkipIfNotOptedIn()` and tests real `.git` directory creation
- `VerifyWorktreeDeletionOverlayTests.Symlink.cs` — calls `SlowIntegration.SkipIfNotOptedIn()`

### 2. GitSim capabilities (as-built)

**Routed commands** (`GitSimCommandRouter.cs`):
`rev-parse`, `ls-files`, `diff`, `diff-tree`, `status`, `add`, `commit`, `commit-tree`, `reset`, `restore`, `checkout`, `stash`, `read-tree`, `write-tree`, `update-ref`, `rm`, `cat-file`, `merge-base`, `rev-list`, `ls-tree`, `bundle`, `fetch`, `cherry-pick`, `log`, `worktree`, `config`, `init`, `symbolic-ref`, `var`, `tag`, `check-ignore`.

**State model** (`State/`): `GitRepository` (refs, objects, identity, index), `GitObjectStore` (blobs/trees/commits), `GitIndex`, `WorkingTree`, `TreeBuilder`, `GitIgnore`, `GitSimRegistry`, `Worktree`.

**Hooks** (`GitSimHooks.cs`): 23-line verdict-delegate model — `SetPreCommit(…)` / `RunPreCommit(…)` returns a verdict struct but never executes real scripts.

**Existing helpers**: `GitSimTestHelpers` (42 lines), `RelayDriverTestHelpers` (72 lines), `ScratchRepo` (150 lines, real-git-only helper).

### 3. GitSim gaps to close

The following command shapes are used by production/test code but not modeled or partially modeled in GitSim:

| Gap | Where needed | Current GitSim status |
|---|---|---|
| **`log --follow` rename tracking** | `CompletionTimeResolverTests.Tier3_GitCommitTime_FollowsRenameIntoCompleted` — expects `git log --follow -1 --format=%cI -- <renamed-path>` to traverse a rename | `Log.cs:24` handles `--follow` but only checks `CommitChangedPath` by comparing tree entries at each commit; it does NOT follow content across renames. Real git's `--follow` detects renames by comparing blob similarity. GitSim must track renames in its commit graph. |
| **`merge --no-ff --no-edit`** | `ScratchRepo.CreateMergeAsync` — used by `HistoryRewriterTests.ExportAsync_MergeCommitInRange_FailsClearly` | Not in GitSim command router. GitSim has no `merge` handler. |
| **`bundle create` with `^base` exclusion range** | `FlaggedWorkStore.CaptureAsync` (line 115): `bundle create <path> <ref> ^<runBaseSha>` | `Bundle.cs:35-48` only handles ref+tip, ignores `^base`. The `^base` syntax means "exclude objects reachable from base." |
| **`fetch <bundle> +ref:ref` with refspec** | `FlaggedWorkStore.RestoreAsync` (line 172): `fetch <bundle> +<src>:<dst>` | `Fetch` handler exists (line 51-69) and handles the +ref:ref pattern. Needs verification. |
| **`-c core.fileMode=true add -A`** | `FlaggedWorkStore.CaptureAsync` (line 68-69) | GitSim's `add` needs to handle `-c` config override prefix (currently unsupported — would return `Unsupported`). |
| **Hook file model / `HookInstaller`** | `HookInstallerTests` (7 tests) init a real repo then call `HookInstaller.InstallAsync` which writes a real pre-commit file to `.git/hooks/` | The hook FILE is written to the real filesystem; GitSim never creates `.git/hooks/pre-commit`. `HookInstaller.cs:61` defaults to `new GitInvoker()` — it calls `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`, `git config core.hooksPath`, etc. The migration must inject GitSim for the git queries while letting the installer write the real hook file (which is on the real filesystem). |
| **`worktree add --detach <path> HEAD`** | `TaskRewriteRunnerTests` — PlanningWorktree creates detached worktrees | `Worktree.cs` already handles `add`, `remove`, `prune`. Needs verification of `--detach` shape. |
| **`git -C <path>` (external repo)** | `SwivalSubagentRunnerContractRetryTests` — creates a separate git repo for `check-ignore` | `TestGit.Run` shells out. GitSim is root-registered; cross-repo commands may need a separate GitSim instance. |
| **`cat-file -t` / `cat-file commit`** | AuthorshipClaimer | `Plumbing.Query.cs` has `CatFile`. Check for the `commit` type shape. |

### 4. Production seams defaulting to `new GitInvoker()` (8 total)

These are the `gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker()` fallbacks in production code that must be eliminated:

| # | File:Line | Context |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Init/ProjectBootstrapper.cs:67` | `BootstrapAsync` — `var gi = gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker();` |
| 2 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Queue/RelayQueueController.cs:163` | `DrainAsync` — `_gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker()` passed to `PlanPhaseRunner` |
| 3 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Queue/RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs:40` | `ResetAndLogAsync` — `var gi = _gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker();` |
| 4 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Init/GitBootstrapper.cs:17` | `IsRepositoryAsync` — `var gi = gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker();` |
| 5 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Init/GitBootstrapper.cs:31` | `EnsureRepositoryAsync` — `var gi = gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker();` |
| 6 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Init/SetupCommitHelper.cs:29` | Setup commit helper |
| 7 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/ObsidianBridge/ObsidianVaultLayout.cs:113` | `ResolveProjectFolderNameAsync` |
| 8 | `src/VisualRelay.Core/Init/HookInstaller.cs:61` | `InstallAsync` — `var gi = gitInvoker ?? new GitInvoker();` |

**Composition roots** that explicitly construct `GitInvoker` (acceptable — these stay):
- `tools/VisualRelay.DrainQueue/Program.cs`
- `tools/VisualRelay.RunTask/Program.cs`

Seams 1, 2, and 3 are the highest-impact (task description specifically calls out `ProjectBootstrapper.cs:67`, `RelayQueueController.cs:162`, `RelayQueueController.PrivateHelpers.cs:40`).

### 5. Migration plan — family-by-family (recommended order)

The recommended order follows the task brief: cheapest → most expensive, one commit per family.

| # | Family | Real-git ops | GitSim gaps | Production seams blocked by |

grep -rl 'TestGit\.Run' tests/VisualRelay.Tests/ --include='*.cs' | grep -v obj/ | wc -l
